caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armchair with a tall, rectangular backrest that extends above the headrest area. The chair is predominantly brown, displaying woodgrain patterns throughout its surface, including the backrest, seat, and arms. The armrests are curvilinear with bulbous support structures and shaped ends. The chair has four sturdy, turned legs connected by horizontal stretchers, which are also turned and have decorative elements. The side stretchers have a scalloped lower edge, and each leg terminates in a small, rounded foot. The backrest features some scrollwork detailing along its vertical edges. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, focusing entirely on the detailed rendering of the chair.
title: Jacobean Chair-table
